snippet.title: The Age of Bhaarat: Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
The Age of Bhaarat is coming! The first global AAA game based on an Indian subject!

This is an Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world inspired by ancient India. Become a Forest Warden and master arcane powers to defend your homeland against a devastating Rakshas demonic invasion.

Prepare to enter a world of destruction and discovery created by Indian legends like Amish Tripathi, acclaimed author of the Shiva Trilogy, and legendary actor Amitabh Bachchan.

Leave your mark on the fate of Bhaarat itself!

Wishlist the game now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3323210/The_Age_of_Bhaarat/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-age-of-bhaarat-b03683


#TheAgeOfBhaarat #AmitabhBachchan #TaraGaming #IndianGaming #AAA
